messages:
Mira (CSM): Heads-up: BrightFarm (acct: bf-77) shows onboarding plateau. trial day 8, only sandbox token test. health dropped to 46. thinking an 'activation garden' micro-sprint to save them. :seedling:
OnboardBot: Auto-alert: low-usage + trial-near-end. health_score 73 -> 46 (rule: 72h no progress).
Mira (CSM): Proposed: 1) 30m focused pairing to run first inference and embed index, 2) $275 starter credit, 3) curated sample repo + 2-minute async clip, 4) capture 4-question quick feedback.
Lena (AM): agree. add a clear step-down path so they know billing won't surprise them. draft: safety-pause (30d trial extension) -> Starter tier (reduced quota, 25% price cut) -> opt-in help window.
Sam (Enablement): I can run the 30m slot. agenda: 5m goals, 12m live integration, 8m fix blockers, 5m next steps. will prep a tiny repo and a curl + node snippet.
Kofi (Support): I'll open ticket SUP-7704 and attach recent logs. can someone confirm if they saw rate-limit or auth errors?
Mira (CSM): logs show 401s during token exchange and a 429 in a single burst. I'll paste snippets into SUP-7704. Use staging keys only during pairing.
Jon (CS Ops): $275 credit approved. please file the credit request with reason and link to SUP-7704. non-refundable unless platform outage.
Dana (RevOps): tagging account: "activation_garden_active"=true start_ts=4960001234 for cohort metrics. will track conversion and cohort revenue delta.
BrightFarm: Quick question  can we get the async clip first? our infra team is busy.
Mira (CSM): Yes we can send async clip as fallback. live preferred but fallback = 15-min async lab + $150 credit.
Sam (Enablement): Async clip outline: token check, minimal curl, embedding create. snippet: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"tiny-embed","input":["doc a","doc b"]}'```
Kofi (Support): SUP-7704 created and assigned to eng-oncall. adding SDK version note and sample error paste.
Mira (CSM): Feedback form (4 Qs) draft: 1) Primary blocker (select: auth, sample-data, SDK, infra) 2) Was the session helpful? (yes/no) 3) Net easing (1-5) 4) One suggestion. Please paste verbatim answers into SUP-7704.
Lena (AM): KPI = health >= 68 and first 3 successful calls within 5 days. if not met, trigger step-down path and schedule 1:1 renewal review.
Jon (CS Ops): I'll add a credit note and approval to ticket CSOPS-4021. please include acceptance checkbox in email: "I accept safety-pause terms" when offering pause.
Dana (RevOps): Also add boolean field: "activation_garden_opted" and store start_ts=4960001234. I'll create a report row.
BrightFarm: We prefer Wed 11am UTC for pairing. staging keys only. thanks Mira.
Mira (CSM): Wed 11am UTC booked. Sam, Kofi please confirm.
Sam (Enablement): Confirmed. I'll upload repo and clip link after session.
Kofi (Support): Confirmed. pairing rota assigned and on-call notified.
OnboardBot: Post-session probe scheduled at 4960001980 (+12h).
Mira (CSM): Action owners: Mira=customer comms + feedback capture; Sam=run session + async clip + repo; Kofi=SUP-7704 + logs; Jon=credit ticket CSOPS-4021; Dana=telemetry and cohort.
Mira (CSM): Closing loop for now. please paste session notes and verbatim feedback here after the meeting. if KPI not met, Lena will lead step-down. thanks team :raised_hands:
